bpmnRequirements.basis: Reviewed requirement dispositions; supported/rejected is a decided disposition, not delivery acceptance.

cibVariants.basis: Canonical registered variants with selected CIB evidence; selection is not current qualification.

wholeModelJourneys.basis: Corpus declarations and local content bindings; catalog eligibility is not a passing journey result.

mechanismMaturity.basis: Existing non-conformance family classifications; no completion stage is inferred.

missingInputs: A reviewed complete mapping from required Practical CIB7 behavioral variants/combinations to stable variant IDs and exact scope.

Dated acceptance evidence bound to each stable variant, exact source/profile and scope, covering applicable Lean/core, CIB, Temporal recovery/replay, whole-model journey and independent closure; pending, failed and missing evidence stays open.

limitations: Tracker stages do not establish end-to-end Practical CIB7 acceptance or its exact remaining variants.
Reviewed requirements and registered variants are bounded inventories, not complete conformance or Practical CIB7 denominators.
Command receipt durations measure command cost, not engineering effort; snapshot elapsed windows are calendar time.
No percentage or delivery ETA is inferred. External source declarations are not revalidated by this command.
